issues.description: Candidate 52 CD45 is a protein alias of PTPRC; normalized to PTPRC. It is the same gene as candidate 51 but represents a distinct evidence source (Xenium antibody segmentation).
Candidate 22 was recorded with unknown polarity, but the source text explicitly states xFB-5 is HHIP-; marker_polarity was corrected to negative.
Candidate 53 was listed as 'nerve cells (nerve bundle)', but the main text identifies the NRXN1+ cells as Schwann cells; four_layer_category assigned as L2 (Schwann cell).
